title: Nourishing Slovakian-Style Fried Cheese Dumplings
description: A twist on traditional Slovakian fried cheese, this recipe combines the comforting dumplings with the bold flavors of Mexico.
instructions: Combine flour, milk, eggs, and seasonings in a large bowl. Mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat until it reaches 375°F (190°C).
Fry the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and puffed up.
Drain the dumplings on paper towels and serve hot with your favorite toppings, such as sour cream, salsa, or avocado.
